items.summary: Update the app’s global color theme (light + dark) to closely match the look-and-feel of the provided reference site: https://ecyknw7fo3zty.ok.kimi.link/?fbclid=PAT01DUAP-4YZleHRuA2FlbQIxMABzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA81NjcwNjczNDMzNTI0MjcAAadMuj_NcTEPcwDBSvYuAwCrJLUe3-xApO-Gj-LgENU-v-KuAM0nH5yjM7y3QQ_aem_Q9KLBwgFpUm9Uo-4Et5ACw . Implement this by updating the existing Tailwind/Shadcn theme tokens (CSS variables) in frontend/src/index.css so the new palette propagates consistently across all existing UI components (nav, cards, headings, buttons, simulator panels, videos gallery, help bot). Keep RTL behavior unchanged.

Adjust key high-visibility UI surfaces to align with the new theme styling (without changing features or content): Top navigation bar, Intro splash gradient/background treatment, decorated section headings, and the floating help-bot trigger/panel. Use only Tailwind classes and existing theme tokens so the styling matches the updated palette and remains consistent.
